user_authorization: Create an actual Xcode application for this Mac and run the new offline application.

application.name: Ergentics Private Compute
application.build_system: Explicit native Xcode targets, no package resolution, no external dependencies or run-script phases
application.sandbox: App Sandbox true; no networking, iCloud, app groups, user-selected-file access or temporary exceptions; built effective signature checked before entry

source_allowlist.excluded: All executable mains, bootstrap, production Prime/DriverCore, dirty research drafts and original package manifests

inputs.carrier_policy: Bundle both existing hex carriers independently; decode/size/hash-check before projection. Never synthesize CBOR from JSON.

sequence: validate pinned candidate/semantic roots, graph equality and ABSTAIN prestate
persist all raw bytes and terminal manifest
execution.independence: Three separate library modules/algorithms and two separate carriers; not separate processes or address spaces.
execution.environment: Normal native GUI environment; record only count and known CF-key presence, never values. No environment-isEmpty predicate or env clearing.
execution.once: One app-owned state and one exclusive fixed run leaf. Existing leaf prevents recomputation or write retry; reopening may display validated retained bytes only.

persistence.base: User-domain Application Support URL supplied by FileManager inside the app sandbox; private ErgenticsPrivateCompute directory
persistence.primitive: Fixed-arity native C openat O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, exact allowlisted names, mode/vnode/link checks, bounded write/readback comparison, checked file and directory sync. No cleanup/replacement/repair.
persistence.terminal: Written last; includes hashes/byte counts of every earlier raw leaf; does not contain its own digest
persistence.failure: Retain prefix; surface exact stage/error; mathematical PASS and persistence success are separate. No automatic rerun.
persistence.limits: Local retained data, not remote archive, encryption, VM isolation or unconditional power-loss proof; filesystem I/O may block even though there is no child-containment loop.

display.graph: Only joined authoritativeGraph; decode for display after validation. Show actual state/witness/relation IDs and predicates.
display.status: STATIC PASS only on mathematical verification; saved receipt status separately; Gate E ABSTAIN / vector00000000 always
display.timing: Record UTC start/end plus mach_absolute_time ticks and integer numerator/denominator; rational duration kept exact; approximate UI duration labeled.
display.energy_reason: Not measured; no CPU time relabeling as energy.

build_and_launch.build_outputs: Fresh retained workspace build directory outside admitted source roots; ordinary app build and pure unit tests, not legacy one-shot envelopes.
build_and_launch.launch: Open signed sandboxed app via LaunchServices only after source/build/signature and three independent reviews. No reuse of consumed bootstrap or its roots. User request authorizes the new bounded app launch.
build_and_launch.tests: Pure fixed-input positive/negative tests; not app receipt creation or old subprocess tests.

reviews_before_source.identity_integration: PASS with Xcode library targets instead of manifest edits
reviews_before_source.security: PASS subject to built entitlements/exclusive persistence/once-state checks
reviews_before_source.roadmap: PASS new local static scope only
